correctness.rationale: The wheel coloring condition is proved equivalent to a proper cyclic-square word with all color classes odd. The minimum palettes have independent lower bounds and explicit seed words that extend in increments of six. The signed ordered-pair trace bijection and character expansion yield exact count formulas; the six integer characteristic polynomials are recomputed from independent exact Newton traces of defined 12x12 and 20x20 matrices. The 14-rim count agrees by parity dynamic programming and separate 30-state signed trace calculation. The primitive unsigned transfer and strict signed comparison through triangle products prove the exponential constants. The code checked the original graph condition, not merely an abstract derived recurrence.

value.rationale: A chromatic number does not determine how many optimum colorings occur. The theorem enumerates every optimal labeled wheel coloring, handles the exceptional 14-rim graph, and proves sharply different entropy regimes: constant 24 on one infinite odd residue class and exponential growth on the other two. It is motivated by the exact wheel invariant solved in the published 2026 primary paper, not by an arbitrary finite slice.
